## Author checklist

- [ ] This PR addresses the linked issue without unrelated changes.
- [ ] I tested the relevant success and failure cases.
- [ ] I added or updated meaningful automated tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I documented any incomplete work or known limitations.
- [ ] I removed secrets and private data from code and screenshots.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change meets the issue's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] The implementation and tests are understandable.
- [ ] Permissions, ownership, and validation are enforced where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant loading, error, retry, and conflict behavior is handled.
- [ ] Required checks pass.
- [ ] Dependencies and compatibility changes are understood.
- [ ] Review feedback is resolved.
- [ ] Only fully completed issues are marked "Closes."
